title: Sources & further reading
body:
Facts in this guide were checked directly against operator and official sources where possible: Hinomaru Bus and Hinomaru Hire (the Kurayoshi–Misasa transfer, bus and jumbo taxi), Misasakan ryokan (the reserved-shuttle alternative), JR Odekake Net (Kurayoshi Station accessibility), Misasa Onsen's official portal, Sanbutsu-ji/Mitokusan, Misasa Town, Tottori City's tourism site (the dunes' free entry, the bus from Tottori Station, the camels' morning path), Kurayoshi tourism (the Shirakabe bus stand and the district's guide service), the Sand Museum, the Uradome cruise listing for San'in Matsushima Yuran, Yakiniku Masashige, Marutsu (crab-season regulatory data), JNTO for entry rules and emergency information, and XE for the reference exchange rate. Crowd-timing and party-size-feasibility notes on the Sand Dunes and Menya Hachibee rest on independently corroborated firsthand accounts (banzokubiology.com, note.com/nambuline_love, na-na.media, umazeriko.hatenablog.com), each cross-checked against a second independent source before shipping.

A few facts remain flagged rather than confirmed: the Kurayoshi–Misasa public bus's exact fare (the operator's own fare table is a PDF that couldn't be read), Menya Hachibee's hours and its ¥780 bowl price (no qualifying primary source located for either), public-transport access to the Uradome Coast cruise departure point (the operator's page publishes only its address, 岩美郡岩美町大谷2182), the rental-waraji price at Sanbutsu-ji (the temple says only that they cost something), the round-trip time for the Nageiredo climb (neither the temple nor Misasa Onsen's portal publishes one), and Japan's current US travel-advisory level (travel.state.gov blocked plain fetches here). These are called out inline where they appear.

Two absences are deliberate rather than flagged. The Uradome cruise entry carries no map pin: the coordinates it shipped with resolved to Matsushima in Miyagi Prefecture, some 600 km away, and no verified replacement could be produced in this pass — an honest blank beats a pin in the wrong prefecture. And no Tottori-city restaurant is recommended for the arrival night; the food picks that cleared this guide's bar are both in Kurayoshi, so Day 1 says so instead of filling the slot with something unverified.
